name: BOSIE Unisex Oversized Long Puffer Down Jacket with Detachable Scarf Collar (Size XL)
description: Wrap yourself in absolute warmth and designer streetstyle charm! This genuine BOSIE unisex long puffer down jacket features an ultra-cozy, oversized cloud-like silhouette in a clean off-white cream colorway. Packed with high-loft premium down filling, it delivers intense insulation against harsh winter freezing winds while remaining surprisingly lightweight. It features a unique, modern collarless round-neck design wrapped with sleek silver-tone hardware snap buttons, and comes complete with its original detachable high-neck down scarf/muffler collar attachment for ultimate cold-weather layering versatility. Please note: This comes from a pet-friendly home with a cat. The jacket has been fully laundered, meticulously sanitized, and lint-rolled. It is in fantastic clean condition with zero rips, stains, or down leakage—ready to tackle the next winter snow storm in style!
contact_note: Cat-friendly home. Meticulously cleaned, deeply sanitized with allergen-free detergent, and thoroughly lint-rolled one final time right before your pickup! Includes the original matching detachable scarf collar attachment. Please note that it does not come with a garment storage bag.
meta_description: Pre-owned genuine BOSIE unisex oversized long puffer down jacket in size XL with detachable high-neck scarf collar. Cream off-white color, snap buttons, freshly laundered, pet-friendly home, no storage bag.
name_zh: BOSIE 伯喜 冬季新款情侣装休闲加厚长款保暖羽绒服 (带可拆卸围脖/XL码/米白色)
description_zh: 潮牌国货顶流、冬日高阶防寒御寒的面包服画质天花板！这款原装 BOSIE 伯喜设计师长款羽绒服，购于淘宝官方旗舰店。采用高级治愈的米白/奶油色外观，内里填充高蓬松度优质羽绒，带来云朵般的轻盈与极致保暖。独特的极简圆领无领设计搭配质感无敌的银色按扣（Snap buttons），最惊艳的是自带一条原装【同色同材质可拆卸高领围脖/充气围巾】，可随心变换为保暖高领结构或搭配连帽衫进行高街叠穿，版型极具微宽廓形感。特别说明：家里养猫。发布前已经过全面深度洗涤、高温消毒与除毛处理，成色极佳，无跑绒、无污责。注：本品不含包装收纳袋。
